result.topic_en: Faint pencil calculations of the total differentials of a map $(x,y,a,b)$ in terms of $(\xi,\eta,\alpha,\beta)$ and of the line element $ds^2$, with conditions for conformality expressed via complex combinations, followed by a Fourier-series computation of coefficients involving $e^{kxi}$ and factorial-type products $\Pi$.
result.transcription:
$dx = \frac{\partial x}{\partial \xi} d\xi + \frac{\partial x}{\partial \eta} d\eta + \frac{\partial x}{\partial \alpha} d\alpha + \frac{\partial x}{\partial \beta} d\beta$
$dy = \frac{\partial y}{\partial \xi} d\xi + \frac{\partial y}{\partial \eta} d\eta + \frac{\partial y}{\partial \alpha} d\alpha + \frac{\partial y}{\partial \beta} d\beta$
$da = \frac{\partial a}{\partial \xi} d\xi + \frac{\partial a}{\partial \eta} d\eta + \frac{\partial a}{\partial \alpha} d\alpha + \frac{\partial a}{\partial \beta} d\beta$
$db = \frac{\partial b}{\partial \xi} d\xi + \frac{\partial b}{\partial \eta} d\eta + \frac{\partial b}{\partial \alpha} d\alpha + \frac{\partial b}{\partial \beta} d\beta$
$ds^2 \cdots = (d\xi^2 + d\eta^2)\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \xi}^2 + \frac{\partial y}{\partial \xi}^2 \cdots\right) + (d\alpha^2 + d\beta^2)\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \alpha}^2 + \frac{\partial y}{\partial \alpha}^2 \cdots\right)$
$2(d\xi\, d\alpha + d\eta\, d\beta)\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \xi}\frac{\partial x}{\partial \alpha} \cdots\right) + 2(d\xi\, d\beta - d\eta\, d\alpha)\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \xi}\frac{\partial x}{\partial \beta} \cdots\right)$
$\frac{\partial x}{\partial \xi}\frac{\partial x}{\partial \alpha} \cdots = 0 \quad \frac{\partial x}{\partial \xi}\frac{\partial x}{\partial \beta} = 0$
$\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \xi} + \frac{\partial y}{\partial \xi} i\right)\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \alpha} - \frac{\partial y}{\partial \alpha} i\right) + \left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial \xi} + \frac{\partial b}{\partial \xi} i\right)\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial \alpha} - \frac{\partial b}{\partial \alpha} i\right)$
$\frac{\frac{\partial x}{\partial \alpha} - \frac{\partial y}{\partial \alpha} i}{\frac{\partial a}{\partial \alpha} - \frac{\partial b}{\partial \alpha} i} = f(\xi + \eta i, \alpha + \beta i) = f_1(\xi - \eta i, \alpha - \beta i) = \text{const. q. e. a.}$
$\left(\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial r}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\partial u}{r \partial \varphi}\right)^2\right)\left(\left[\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \alpha}\right)^2 \cdots\right] + 2 r \cos\varphi \left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \alpha}\frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial \beta \partial \alpha} \cdots\right) + 2 r \sin\varphi \left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \alpha}\frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial \beta \partial \alpha} \cdots\right)$
$+ r^2 \left(\frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial \beta \partial \alpha}\right)^2 \cdots\Big]$
$+ \left(\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial \alpha}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial \beta}\right)^2\right)\left(\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \beta}\right)^2 + \partial \cdots\right)$
$\pi e^{kxi} = \sum_{-\infty,\infty} \int_{-\pi}^{\pi} e^{kyi} e^{n(x-y)i} dy = \sum_{-\infty,\infty} a_n$
$\sum_{m,\infty} a_n = \Pi(m-k-1)(-1)^{m-1} 2 m i \pi k\, e^{(m-1)xi} \sum_{0,\infty} \frac{\Pi \mu}{\Pi(m-k+\mu)} (e^{-xi}+1)^{-\mu-1}$
$= \pi e^{kxi} - \Pi(k-m)(-1)^{m-1} 2 m i \pi k\, e^{mxi} \sum_{0,\infty} \frac{\Pi \mu}{\Pi(k-m+\mu+1)} (e^{xi}+1)^{-\mu-1}$

methods.what: Total differentials of four functions of four variables (chain rule)
methods.quote: $dx = \frac{\partial x}{\partial \xi} d\xi + \frac{\partial x}{\partial \eta} d\eta + \frac{\partial x}{\partial \alpha} d\alpha + \frac{\partial x}{\partial \beta} d\beta$

methods.what: Expansion of the line element $ds^2$ in new coordinates, grouped by $d\xi^2+d\eta^2$, $d\alpha^2+d\beta^2$ and mixed terms
methods.quote: $ds^2 \cdots = (d\xi^2 + d\eta^2)\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \xi}^2 + \frac{\partial y}{\partial \xi}^2 \cdots\right) + (d\alpha^2 + d\beta^2)\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial \alpha}^2 + \frac{\partial y}{\partial \alpha}^2 \cdots\right)$

methods.what: Orthogonality conditions for vanishing mixed terms
Ratio of complex derivative combinations is both holomorphic and antiholomorphic, hence constant
methods.quote: $\frac{\frac{\partial x}{\partial \alpha} - \frac{\partial y}{\partial \alpha} i}{\frac{\partial a}{\partial \alpha} - \frac{\partial b}{\partial \alpha} i} = f(\xi + \eta i, \alpha + \beta i) = f_1(\xi - \eta i, \alpha - \beta i) = \text{const. q. e. a.}$

methods.what: Fourier expansion of $e^{kxi}$ (non-integer $k$) with coefficient integrals
Closed form for the tail sum of Fourier coefficients as a series in powers of $(e^{\mp xi}+1)^{-1}$ with Gauss Pi-function ratios

items.quote: $= f_1(\xi - \eta i, \alpha - \beta i) = \text{const. q. e. a.}$
